rows.rationale: PO, receipt GR-7701 and invoice all agree at 200 EACH @ $4.20 (clauses 1, 3, 4), and recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% rate is exactly the invoiced $63.00 (clause 5). No non-PO lines, no credit memos, no prior invoices to match against. Clean 3-way match; net payable $903.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

The only exception was a unit-of-measure difference: the supplier billed 480 EACH @ $2.00 against a PO for 40 CASE @ $24.00 with pack size 12 (vendor.json). Normalised per clause 2, quantity, unit price and line total reconcile exactly; receipt GR-7702 confirms 40 CASE delivered (clause 4), and recomputed tax at 7.5% equals the supplier's $72.00 (clause 5). UOM normalisation is not a defect (clause 11.1), so the invoice is a clean match payable at $1,032.00 with AP_CLERK approval (clause 10).

The $1.10/EACH price increase (63.10 vs PO 62.00) sits inside the clause 3 band, which is the lower of 2% ($1.24) and $50.00, so it is not a defect. Three-way match on the GOODS PO is complete: 100 EACH ordered, received (GR-7703) and invoiced with no UOM difference (clause 1, 4). Tax of $473.25 equals 7.5% of the corrected net exactly (clause 5), and there are no credit memos, so $6,783.25 is payable at AP_CLERK authority (clauses 9, 10).

defects: Price variance outside tolerance and uncured: invoiced $154.00/EACH vs PO $145.00/EACH (+6.21%), allowance $2.90 (clause 3)
rows.rationale: Quantities match the receipt exactly (80 EACH ordered, received, invoiced) and tax at 7.5% recomputes to $924.00 exactly, so the only issue is price. The unit price is $154.00 against a PO price of $145.00, a 6.21% increase versus an allowance of the lower of 2% ($2.90) and $50.00, so it is outside tolerance (clause 3). The only supporting document is a unilateral supplier price-increase notice from Kestrel's billing department; it is not from or countersigned by an authorised buyer (Dele Fashanu or Priya Raman), so it does not cure the variance under clause 3.1. Single defect, so HOLD_PRICE_VARIANCE at $0.00 rather than escalation (clauses 11, 12).

The 6.0% unit-price increase ($88.00 -> $93.28) exceeds the clause 3 band (lower of 2% / $50.00 = $1.76), but is cured under clause 3.1: authorised buyer Dele Fashanu approved up to 6% on PO-4405, conduit line only, in writing. Receipt GR-7705 confirms 60 EACH ordered/received/invoiced with no quantity variance (clause 4), and recomputed tax at 7.5% matches the supplier's $419.76 exactly (clause 5). No credit memos; net payable $6,016.56 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clauses 9-10).

defects: Quantity shortfall: 100 EACH invoiced, only 60 EACH received (40 on backorder)
rows.rationale: GR-7706 records only 60 of the 100 EACH invoiced, with 40 on backorder; under clause 4 the dispute resolves in favour of the receipt, so pay 60 x $9.50 = $570.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3) and no UOM conversion is needed. Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate on the corrected net is $42.75, giving $612.75 gross; the supplier's $71.25 is simply tax on the unreceived units, not an independent tax error, so this remains a single defect and clause 11 escalation is not triggered. No credit memos; $612.75 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Suspected duplicate: all five clause 8 conditions met against paid prior invoice NW-9912
rows.rationale: All five clause 8 duplicate conditions hold against prior invoice NW-9912 (already PAID): same vendor after name normalisation (Nordwind Supply Co. / Nordwind Supply Company LLC), same PO-4407, identical gross of $3,225.00, invoices 19 days apart, and neither invoice carries a service period, so clause 8.1's recurring-charge exemption does not apply. Price, quantity (25 EACH ordered, received and invoiced) and tax (7.5% = $225.00 exactly) all reconcile, so the only defect is the duplicate; a single defect does not trigger clause 11 escalation. Payable is $0.00 per clause 12.

The prior invoice INV-3221 matches on vendor, PO, amount and date window, but carries a distinct non-overlapping service period (Feb 2026 vs Mar 2026), so under clause 8.1 this is a legitimate monthly retainer charge, not a duplicate. Price matches the blanket PO exactly (clause 3), tax at the vendor's 7.5% recomputes to $360.00 exactly (clause 5), and no goods receipt is expected on a SERVICES PO (clause 1). Net payable $5,160.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

Goods line matches PO and receipt exactly (150 EACH at $18.00, clauses 3-4), and tax of $231.00 equals the recomputed 7.5% on the $3,080.00 net (clause 5). The $380.00 expedited freight line is permitted: contract clause 6.2 allows pass-through of buyer-requested expedited carriage up to $500.00, and the goods receipt records that production requested overnight delivery, so it is not a surcharge defect under clause 6. No defects; payable $3,311.00 requires AP_CLERK approval (clause 10).

defects: Tax overcharge: supplier billed $744.00 tax (12%) on a net of $6,200.00 where the vendor rate is 7.5% ($465.00), a $279.00 discrepancy (clause 5).
rows.rationale: Price, quantity and receipt all match exactly (clauses 3-4, GR-7710 confirms 200 EACH). The only defect is tax: recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate the tax is $465.00, not the $744.00 billed, so the supplier overcharged by $279.00 — clause 5 requires SHORT_PAY of the corrected total $6,665.00. Single defect, so no escalation under clause 11; no credit memos to net (clause 9); $6,665.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

Contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated in Q1 2026, so the PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH normalises to USD 231.00 — exactly the invoiced price (policy clause 7 conversion is normalisation, not a defect; clause 3 variance 0%). Receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 EACH received against 40 ordered and invoiced (clause 4), and tax at the vendor's 7.5% recomputes to USD 693.00, matching the supplier (clause 5). No surcharge lines, no prior invoices or open credit memos; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Over-delivery beyond 5%: 118 EACH received against a PO quantity of 100 EACH (18% over, clause 4)
rows.rationale: Both sides are already in the PO's unit (EACH, no CASE conversion needed) and the unit price matches the PO exactly, so there is no price issue. The receipt shows 118 EACH delivered against 100 ordered — an 18% over-delivery, far beyond the 5% tolerance in clause 4 — so the invoice is held for receiving/buyer action with payable 0.00 (clause 12). Only this single defect is present, so clause 11 escalation is not triggered.

PO-4413 is a SERVICES PO, so the absent goods receipt that failed the ERP three-way match is normal and not a defect (clause 1). Invoiced price matches the PO exactly (clause 3), tax of 562.50 equals the recomputed 7.5% figure (clause 5), and there are no prior invoices or credit memos (clauses 8, 9). Net payable 8,062.50 USD falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Quantity shortfall: 1,200 CASE invoiced vs 1,050 CASE received (clause 4 under-delivery)
Tax overcharge: supplier billed 9% ($3,240.00) against a 7.5% rate; correct tax on corrected net is $2,362.50 (clause 5)
rows.rationale: UOM normalises cleanly (30,000 EACH at $1.20 = 1,200 CASE at $30.00, pack size 25), so price is exactly at PO (clause 2, 3). Two defects exist: the receipt shows only 1,050 of 1,200 cases delivered, so payment is limited to received quantity ($31,500.00 net) under clause 4; and the supplier's tax of $3,240.00 reflects a 9% rate against the vendor's 7.5%, correct tax being $2,362.50 (clause 5). Corrected gross $33,862.50 less open credit memo CM-2026-014 of $1,500.00 gives $32,362.50 (clause 9). Two defects plus a net payable above $25,000.00 both force escalation under clause 11, with CONTROLLER approval per clause 10.

defects: Quantity shortfall on line 4: 25 gland plates invoiced, 20 received (clause 4) — payable recomputed on 20 @ $120.00 = $2,400.00
Tax overcharge: supplier billed $609.84 (9% of its net) versus $463.20 at the vendor's 7.5% rate on the corrected net of $6,176.00, a $146.64 discrepancy (clause 5)
rows.rationale: Line 2 reconciles exactly once the 40 CASE are normalised to 480 EACH at $2.05 (clause 2, not a defect), and line 3's $0.80 uplift sits inside the $0.90 band (clause 3). Two genuine defects remain: the gland-plate under-delivery (20 of 25 received, clause 4) and a tax overcharge computed at 9% instead of the vendor's 7.5% (clause 5). Two defects on one invoice force ESCALATE_HUMAN under clause 11, with a recommended corrected payable of $6,176.00 net plus $463.20 tax = $6,639.20; no open credit memos apply (clause 9).

defects: Price variance outside tolerance and uncured: invoiced $4,075.00/EACH vs PO $4,000.00/EACH, variance $75.00 against an allowed band of $50.00 (lower of 2% = $80.00 and $50.00)
rows.rationale: Quantities match exactly (2 EACH ordered, received, invoiced) and tax recomputes to $611.25 exactly, so the only issue is price: the $75.00/unit increase exceeds the clause 3 band, which is the lower of 2% ($80.00) and $50.00. No correspondence or contract in the case file provides authorisation from a listed buyer referencing PO-4416, so clause 3.1 does not cure it. One defect only, so no clause 11 escalation; clause 12 sets the payable to $0.00 pending buyer action.

defects: Price variance outside tolerance and uncured: invoiced $19.60/EACH vs PO $18.00/EACH (+8.89%, allowance $0.36)
rows.rationale: The armoured cable was invoiced at $19.60/EACH against a PO price of $18.00/EACH — a $1.60 (8.89%) variance, far outside the clause 3 band (lower of 2% = $0.36 or $50.00). The only surcharge approval for PO-4417 came from Femi Okonkwo, a warehouse supervisor who is not in vendor.json authorised_buyers, so clause 3.1 does not cure it; the Dele Fashanu approval is expressly limited to PO-4405. Quantities match the receipt (500 EACH) and tax recomputes exactly at 7.5%, so this is the single defect: hold for buyer action under clause 12 with payable $0.00.

defects: Unauthorised non-PO charge: $640.00 delivery and handling line exceeds the $500.00 pass-through limit (clause 6)
rows.rationale: Line 1 matches the PO exactly on price and quantity (6 EACH @ $410.00, all 6 received per GR-7718), so the goods portion is clean. The decisive fact is line 2: contract clause 6.2 permits passing through oversize carrier cost, but clause 6 of the policy also caps any non-PO line at $500.00, and this charge is $640.00 with no buyer authorisation on file. That single unauthorised-surcharge defect gives HOLD_PRICE_VARIANCE at $0.00 (clauses 6, 11.1, 12); the resulting $48.00 tax overstatement is derivative of that same line, not a separate defect.

defects: Tax undercharged: supplier billed $65.00 vs recomputed $97.50 at the vendor's 7.5% rate (clause 5 tax discrepancy, $32.50 shortfall)
rows.rationale: Price and quantity match exactly (400 EACH @ $3.25, receipt GR-7719 confirms 400 received), so clauses 3 and 4 are clean. The only defect is tax: the supplier applied 5% instead of the vendor's 7.5% rate, undercharging $32.50. Per clause 5, an undercharge is paid at the recomputed higher correct total of $1,397.50 and flagged for tax-compliance exposure. Single defect and payable under $25,000, so no escalation under clause 11; AP_CLERK approval per clause 10.

Receipt confirms 206 EACH delivered against a PO for 200 — a 3% over-delivery, within the 5% tolerance and therefore not a defect (clause 4), so the received/invoiced quantity is payable. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3) and the supplier's tax of $125.15 is within $0.01 of the recomputed 7.5% figure, i.e. rounding only (clause 5). No credit memos outstanding; net payable $1,793.75 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

Price, quantity and tax all reconcile exactly against the PO and goods receipt (clauses 3, 4, 5), so the invoice is clean with no defects. The open $2,000.00 credit memo CM-2026-021 nets against the $1,522.20 gross and floors the payable at $0.00 (clause 9); credit-memo netting is not a defect. Net payable $0.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

PO-4422 is a SERVICES PO, so a 2-way match applies and the absent goods receipt is not a defect (clause 1). The invoice carries a distinct service period (2026-02-15/2026-03-14) versus the prior paid invoice HL-3301 (2026-02-01/2026-02-28), and the billed name does not normalise to the prior name, so clause 8's conditions are not all met — this is a legitimate recurring charge under clause 8.1, not a duplicate. Unit price equals the PO price (clause 3), tax of $300.00 matches 7.5% of the $4,000.00 net exactly (clause 5), and no credit memos are open (clause 9). Net payable $4,300.00 requires AP_CLERK approval (clause 10).

The $242.00/EACH invoiced price exceeds the $220.00 PO price by $22.00, outside the clause 3 band (lower of 2% = $4.40 and $50.00), but it is cured under clause 3.1: Priya Raman, a listed authorised buyer, authorised a $250.00-per-enclosure ceiling for PO-4423 in writing, and $242.00 sits within it. Receipt GR-7723 confirms 15 EACH received against 15 ordered and invoiced (clause 4), and recomputed tax at 7.5% equals the supplier's $272.25 exactly (clause 5). No defects; net payable $3,902.25 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced, 52 EACH received (8 kits refused at the dock as damaged)
rows.rationale: Unit price matches the PO exactly and no UOM conversion is needed. GR-7724 records 52 of 60 EACH received (8 refused damaged), so under clause 4 the invoice is short-paid on the received quantity: 52 x $320.00 = $16,640.00 net, with tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate = $1,248.00 (clause 5), giving $17,888.00. The supplier's $1,440.00 tax is correct for its own 7.5% rate and differs only as a consequence of the quantity correction, so this is the single defect and clause 11 escalation is not triggered. Clause 10 puts approval with AP_MANAGER.
